procedural_matters: Before the hearing began, an arbitration was held and ITA 215741 took a 30% Post-Race Penalty in accordance with RRS T1(a), USA 209744 did not withdraw the protest.
Case 6 was heard together with hearing 5 in accordance with RRS 63.(2)(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident.
Case 6 did not identify the incident as required by RRS 60.3(a).
By informing USA 209744 ashore after the races, ITA 215741 failed to hail ‘Protest’ at the first reasonable opportunity, as required by RRS 60.2(a).
As Case 5 is valid, the hearing is continued.
facts: The incident occured in race 11, about 100 metres below the windward mark in the 2nd lap.
USA 209744 on starboard tack and ITA 215741 on port tack, both close-hauled and on a collision course.
When USA 209744 was approximately 2 metres from ITA 215741, ITA 215741 held her course and USA 209744 bore away 40° and crossed 30 cm. astern of ITA 215741.
No contact or injury, no boat took a penalty-turn.
conclusions: ITA 215741 on port tack failed to keep clear of USA 209744 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
decision: Case 5: By failing to keep clear of USA 209744, ITA 215741 broke RRS 10 in race 11 and the 30% post-race-penalty taken is the applicable penalty. Case 6: Protest invalid.
